_comment: Copyable review.v1 skeleton. additionalProperties is false throughout: remove every underscore-prefixed key before writing. Write to .foundry/blackboard/<wave>/appsec-reviewer.json

findings.category: injection | broken-access-control | ssrf | deserialisation | xxe | path-traversal | race-condition | token-misuse | cors | secret-handling | cross-cutting
findings.title: <=120 chars, states the defect, not the topic
findings.summary: <=600 chars. What the code does, and why that is wrong here.
findings.failureScenario: Actor + concrete input + precondition + wrong outcome. No exploit procedure. Required: a finding without one is speculation.
findings.remediation: The change: file, API to switch to, config key. Not a goal.

summary: <=900 chars. Confirmed findings, refutation rate, and what was not covered.
_verdictRule: block if any confirmed critical/high; pass-with-comments if only medium/low/info; pass only when findings is empty
